instruction:
packaging.metadata only folds '
' when writing header values in Metadata.as_rfc822(), and only rejects '
' in single-line fields such as Summary. Other line boundaries break the output: a bare '' makes the email generator raise HeaderWriteError, and on Python releases without the CVE-2024-6923 fix any str.splitlines() boundary ends the header line. Treat every line boundary that str.splitlines() recognises ('
', '
', '', '\v', ' ', '\x1c', '\x1d', '\x1e', '\x85', ' ', ' ') like '
': fold it when writing (so an author of 'HelloWorld' is written as 'author: Hello
        World'), and reject it in a Summary value during validation. Add tests.
instruction_source: written from the fix commit message, linked issue and hidden tests; describes behavior, not the change
